title: SpikeFade: fix 80e6ff471 A-S1 cap falling back to $20 BTC A-S2 stop and reconcile c4ad479e0 A-C2 removal across ItemFourReplay and Paths/Profile
goal: Fix three SpikeFade regressions introduced in the last 24h (CRITICAL_24H_AUDIT_2026-10-30.md Finding 2): (1) Commit 80e6ff471 capped A-S1 stop selection (<= 3%) in SpikeFadeDetector.java:189-197 instead of capping the priorHigh proxy (dayHigh[LOOKBACK-1]) requested by spikefade-prior-day-high-proxy-cap, causing >3% prior highs to fall back to A-S2 (high + 20.0 DAX points = $20 stop on BTC!) rather than returning null. (2) Commit c4ad479e0 removed the A-C2 gate from SpikeFadeDetector.detect(), silently altering SpikeFadePaths.java:13 and SpikeFadeProfile.java:13 which assume A-C2 is enforced by detect(). (3) ItemFourReplay.java:188 still blocks on G4_A-C2_CLOSE_NOT_ABOVE_PRIOR_DAY_HIGH, contradicting SpikeFadeDetector.detect() on 129 bars of 2026-10-29.
steps: In SpikeFadeDetector.java, ensure an out-of-cap prior-day high proxy does not silently fall back to the unscaled 20-point DAX buffer (high + 20.0 = $20 on BTC), and align SpikeFadeCriticalWave1Test with spikefade-prior-day-high-proxy-cap done_when.
Check whether SpikeFadePaths.java and SpikeFadeProfile.java should require sig.c2_above_prior_day or keep C2 as an annotated tag only, and update their comments/logic accordingly.
Synchronize ItemFourReplay.java:188 with SpikeFadeDetector.detect() so the diagnostic gate trace matches the live detector.
done_when: mvn -q -Dtest=SpikeFadeCriticalWave1Test,SpikeFadeDetectorTest test passes and ItemFourReplay.java gate() matches SpikeFadeDetector.detect().
notes: Filed by Gemini 4 Argon (Low) 24h critical audit (MTS-20261030-GEM-AUD-gemini-24h-critical-audit).
